title: Common process UI: reference image, readiness and observed progress
summary: Served Wright UI with controlled HTTP contracts; no model, MCP or engineering dispatch.

manualSteps.label: Open process
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated workspace. Click Workflows, then Use saved process.

manualSteps.label: Provide inputs
manualSteps.instruction: Enter the Design request. Choose a PNG in Reference image. Check its thumbnail and wait for transfer to finish.

manualSteps.label: Prepare and run
manualSteps.instruction: Click Prepare and check inputs, then Start process. Inspect activity and reported progress.

manualSteps.label: Inspect and reopen
manualSteps.instruction: Inspect the completed result. Close the working tab and reopen its saved link.

steps.label: Normal workspace and accepted process
steps.action: Open the isolated workspace and click Workflows.
steps.expected: The accepted process opens in the existing editor.
steps.actual: The normal workspace editor opens; no run is submitted.
steps.summary: The normal workspace editor opens; no run is submitted.

steps.label: Common working tab
steps.purpose: Inspect the optional shared interface on the same process.
steps.expected: Inputs and preparation controls open in a workspace tab.
steps.actual: The common view shows Design request and Reference image; starting is disabled.
steps.summary: The common view shows Design request and Reference image; starting is disabled.

steps.label: Provide the design request
steps.purpose: Gather the declared user input before execution.
steps.action: Enter Make a small test part using the reference image in Design request.
steps.expected: The draft is entered without starting or editing source.
steps.actual: The typed draft stays in the working view and no dispatch occurs.
steps.summary: The typed draft stays in the working view and no dispatch occurs.

steps.label: Uploaded bitmap and pending transfer
steps.purpose: Show the actual selected file and prevent early preparation.
steps.expected: A decoded thumbnail and file-transfer progress are visible; preparation/start remain disabled.
steps.actual: The 96 by 96 bitmap decodes, Preparing file is visible and no process can start while upload is pending.
steps.summary: The 96 by 96 bitmap decodes, Preparing file is visible and no process can start while upload is pending.

steps.label: Transfer finishes before preparation
steps.purpose: Retain an exact scoped file reference.
steps.action: Wait for the file upload to complete.
steps.expected: Preparation becomes available after the scoped upload reply.
steps.actual: The upload's original SHA-256 and process scope are retained; the thumbnail stays visible.
steps.summary: The upload's original SHA-256 and process scope are retained; the thumbnail stays visible.

steps.label: Check all supplied inputs
steps.purpose: Prepare immutable run inputs before starting.
steps.expected: The exact prompt and file binding are prepared, then start becomes permitted.
